author: Zephyr I
title: Early time injection before CNN/LSTM — std-width nodil (BASE_SEED=42)
abstract: A/B ablation: inject time early (into CNN+ConvLSTM) vs late (after pooling). Std-width CNN (32/64) with d=5 on main convs only, undilated bottleneck 3×3s, double-step LN-ConvLSTM(64), single-head AttnPool, AdamW+clip. BASE_SEED=42.
